snippet.title: Pal♡world! ~More Than Just Pals~ | Announcement Trailer | Palworld | Pocketpair
snippet.description:
#Palworld Dating Sim💕
"Pal♡world! ~More Than Just Pals~"

Will you remain friends or fall in love?
Or dismantle and eat them...🍴

Pals take off their clothes⁉️ An adult version will also be released🔞

#AprilFoolsDay
*Update for Palworld is coming soon!

🔥Available Now🔥
#Palworld, the latest open-world survival crafting game.
